summary: Shreya Acquisition Group (a blank-check company) filed an 8-K reporting the closing of its IPO on May 8, 2026. It sold 11,000,000 units at $10.00 per unit, generating $110 million in gross proceeds, including 1,000,000 units from partial exercise of the over-allotment option. Each unit consists of one Class A ordinary share, one redeemable warrant (exercise price $11.50/share), and one right to receive one-fourth of a Class A ordinary share upon a business combination. D. Boral Capital LLC was the underwriters' representative. This is a standard SPAC IPO closing — not a special-situation event under the defined categories.
